_doc: Story 9.2 ANONYMIZED LOVABLE FIXTURE — CRM business shape (customers + facilities + contacts). Preserves the load-bearing CRM shape the later 9.3 comparison depends on: customer_type, an identifier-by-type placeholder (private carries a MASKED personnummer FIELD per owner decision 2026-06-18 — access-controlled, obviously-fake non-\d{6}-\d{4} placeholder; company/brf carry a MASKED orgnr non-\d{10} placeholder), facility binding, and a primary-contact flag. ZERO real PII: names are synthetic labels, emails are @example.test, personnummer/orgnr are masked placeholders, phone/address are synthetic non-matching values. No anonymized real Lovable CRM oracle exists yet (real-capture SELECTION is owner-gated, Sign-Off 8.1/8.2) — cases are origin:new-expected plus one SYNTHETIC documented-delta and one SYNTHETIC old-lovable-placeholder (clearly marked in the note) so the three-way origin machinery is genuinely exercised; NO real captured Lovable number is fabricated. The masked personnummer/orgnr placeholders here NAME the field the ROT flow needs without leaking a real value.

cases.note: A PRIVATE customer carrying an access-controlled personnummer FIELD (owner decision 2026-06-18 — ROT requires it; excluded from list, masked on detail, never in audit) as an OBVIOUSLY-FAKE masked placeholder, bound to one facility and a primary contact. Preserves the customer_type + identifier-by-type + facility-binding + primary-contact shape 9.3 compares.

A COMPANY customer carrying a MASKED orgnr placeholder (non-\d{10}) instead of a personnummer, one facility, and a non-primary contact. Preserves the by-type identifier divergence (personnummer for private, orgnr for company) the CRM oracle must keep.

SYNTHETIC documented-delta (NOT a real captured Lovable value): a BRF-like customer. The plausible Lovable divergence is a CLASSIFICATION difference — Lovable modeled a BRF under the generic 'company' customer_type, whereas Phase A carries a distinct 'brf' customer_type. The divergent old value is a CLASSIFICATION CODE ('company'), exercising the R-913 number|classification-code widening.
